name: 32837 · Orlando, FL
findings: ZIP 32837 (Orlando) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32837 (Orlando) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32837 (Orlando) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

observations.text: 33 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
